items.title: Hirudo: From Fake Updates to Patched Banking Apps
items.content: A new Android banking remote access trojan named Hirudo has been identified, combining credential theft with live remote control. It is delivered through shopping and entertainment apps that act as droppers, installing the trojan as a separate package behind fake update prompts. The malware replaces legitimate banking applications with patched versions that disable security checks from within the... This pulse includes 15 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Finance. Associated malware: Hirudo.

items.title: Ivanti CVE-2026-104935: Zero-Day Chain Exploited in Operation Innovate
items.content: Ivanti has released emergency security updates after attackers exploited a chain of three zero-day vulnerabilities in Connect Secure VPN appliances to gain root-level access without authentication. The attack began on October 3, targeting an appliance running version 22.8R2.4. Two vulnerabilities are tracked as CVE-2026-104935 with a CVSS score of 8.6, involving an authentication bypass and... This pulse includes 2 indicators of compromise (IOCs).

items.title: Fake Calendly "Meta Careers" pages steal Facebook and Google logins
items.content: A wave of fraudulent websites mimicking Calendly booking pages for Meta job interviews has been identified, targeting job seekers to steal credentials. Victims select interview time slots, provide personal information, and complete fake CAPTCHA verifications before being prompted to log into Facebook and Google accounts. items.title: Disruption Targets Major Chinese-Language Phishing Kits with Japanese Focus
items.content: A coordinated disruption action targeted Chinese-speaking cybercriminals operating three major phishing kits: CoGUI, CoAceV, and CoFish_Ws, which collectively distributed hundreds of millions of credential phishing messages primarily targeting Japanese organizations. Targeted industries: Finance, Healthcare, Government.
